policy: Raw calculated shieldings, physical reference models and experimental processing conventions are distinct. A reference is reusable only after nucleus, method, solvent domain, model, input/output hashes and processing convention are all locked.

indirect_reference_routes.limitation: This is a processing convention and has no molecular ORCA reference job.

reference_jobs.raw_calculation_reference: Raw sigma(1H/13C) for TMS calculated at the target shielding method
reference_jobs.experimental_reference_convention: Experimental DMSO-d6 spectra may be processed against residual DMSO; the measured residual-solvent value and spectrometer convention remain separate metadata
reference_jobs.model_limitation: TMS raw shielding is a calculated zero-scale intermediate, not evidence that TMS was added to the author's sample

reference_jobs.experimental_reference_convention: Experimental DMSO-d6 spectra may be processed against residual DMSO; the measured residual-solvent value and spectrometer convention remain separate metadata
reference_jobs.model_limitation: TMS raw shielding is a calculated zero-scale intermediate, not evidence that TMS was added to the author's sample

reference_jobs.raw_calculation_reference: Raw sigma(19F) for CFCl3 calculated at the target shielding method
reference_jobs.experimental_reference_convention: The experimental 19F convention (internal, external or indirect CFCl3 scale) must be copied from the acquisition/processing record
reference_jobs.model_limitation: A CPCM(DMSO) CFCl3 molecule is a declared calculation model and does not prove physical internal CFCl3 was present

reference_jobs.raw_calculation_reference: Raw sigma(31P) for a declared H3PO4·(DMSO)2 cluster model
reference_jobs.experimental_reference_convention: If the experiment used 85 wt% H3PO4 externally, record that external convention and its assigned delta=0 separately
reference_jobs.model_limitation: MODEL_ONLY_NOT_EQUIVALENT_TO_85WT_PERCENT_H3PO4; concentration, water activity, proton exchange and intermolecular structure of the external standard are not reproduced

reference_jobs.raw_calculation_reference: Raw sigma(31P) for a declared H3PO4·(H2O)4 electronic cluster with D isotope masses in the frequency input
reference_jobs.experimental_reference_convention: The actual D2O 31P reference may be external 85 wt% H3PO4 or an indirect scale; record the laboratory convention independently
reference_jobs.model_limitation: MODEL_ONLY_NOT_EQUIVALENT_TO_85WT_PERCENT_H3PO4; this dilute microsolvated model cannot reproduce concentrated acid speciation or bulk susceptibility

reference_jobs.raw_calculation_reference: Raw sigma(1H/13C) for the trimethylsilyl resonance of a declared DSS-/Na+/6D2O cluster
reference_jobs.experimental_reference_convention: Use only if the actual acquisition used DSS with a compatible internal/external convention; concentration, pD and temperature must be recorded
reference_jobs.model_limitation: DSS ion pairing and hydration are model-dependent; this candidate cannot be substituted for TSP or an indirect reference without a new calibration decision

reference_jobs.raw_calculation_reference: Raw sigma(1H/13C) for the trimethylsilyl resonance of a declared TSP-/Na+/6D2O cluster
reference_jobs.experimental_reference_convention: Use only if the actual acquisition used the matching TSP/TSP-d4 convention; indirect referencing remains a separate non-molecular processing route
reference_jobs.model_limitation: Exact isotopologue, pD, sodium ion pairing and hydration must be confirmed; non-deuterated and TSP-d4 models are not silently interchangeable
